name: ZMK Battery
author: Scramble Tools
description: Battery level of each half of a ZMK split keyboard in the Omarchy bar, with a shortcut to ZMK Studio. The peripheral (right) half's level needs CONFIG_ZMK_SPLIT_BLE_CENTRAL_BATTERY_LEVEL_FETCHING=y and CONFIG_ZMK_SPLIT_BLE_CENTRAL_BATTERY_LEVEL_PROXY=y in your ZMK config.

barWidget.description: Per-half battery for a ZMK split keyboard, plus a button to open ZMK Studio. Requires the ZMK split battery fetching and proxy options to show the peripheral half.

schema.label: Keyboard name
schema.description: The Bluetooth name the keyboard advertises (ZMK's default for a Ferris Sweep is Cradio).

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to read the battery levels while the keyboard is connected.

schema.label: Hide the icon when the keyboard is not connected
Central half (left or right)
schema.description: Which half talks to the computer; its battery is listed first.
